findings.note: ESPN's Matt Bowen picks Flournoy as a fantasy pickup against Arizona, not as a receptions prop bet. He says Flournoy has three straight double-digit fantasy games and is Prescott's No. 3 option behind Lamb and Pickens, giving him a stable floor.

ESPN lists Flournoy as Active with 23 catches for 234 yards and 1 TD in the 2026 regular season. The number of games isn't shown, so his per-game catch rate compared with the 3.5 line can't be confirmed here.
NFL.com lists Flournoy as active. In last season's Week 9 game against the Cardinals he caught 2 passes for 12 yards and a TD, below this line. That was a 2025 game with a different role.
